_note: Hostile cases for the PURE half of the installer, src/install.js. The impure half is exercised against a real gzipped tar over a real HTTP server in tools/check-install.mjs; these are the rules that decide, isolated from the I/O that carries them out.

members.name: a/../../b
members.why: Refused even though it resolves inside. A member that walks up and back down is describing a path it has no reason to describe, and the cancelling form is the one that survives review.

members.name: https://evil.test/x
members.reason: "https://evil.test/x" looks like a URL, not a path

members.name: assets\slide.png
members.why: Means one thing on the machine it was packed on and another here.

failures: no such package in the index
id "../etc" is not lowercase letters, digits and hyphens

entries.why: Both path segments come from these, so a version that is not a plain triple is a directory name chosen by a stranger.

failures: sha256 is missing or not 64 hex characters
sha256 is missing or not 64 hex characters
subject "_test" is a test fixture and must not be published
entries.why: The publisher applies the same one-line rule as isTestEngine, so a future boundary fixture cannot forget to opt out.

failures: manifest id "other" is not the index's "m"
manifest id "other" is not the directory "m"
manifest version "9.9.9" is not the index's "0.1.0"
manifest version "9.9.9" is not the directory "0.1.0"
